note: Festival-wide (not per-project) visitor guide data referenced by the chatbot assistant. Unconfirmed items are left as "Not available yet" — update this file once confirmed, no code change or redeploy needed.

food.saleLocations: There is no single food court — food and drinks are sold individually by each project/booth that offers them, at that project's own location.
food.eatableRestAreas: There are eating areas on the 1st floor (near CS/Room 125, just past the middle gate) and on the 3rd floor (next to the library).

restrooms: 1st floor: near the stage (by the girls' changing room) and near the nurse's office (below Room 110 Art Room / Room 111 IC Fusion). 2nd floor: girls' restroom near stairway A (by Room 207), boys' restroom near stairway B (below Room 214 PC Club). 3rd floor: girls' restroom near stairway A, boys' restroom near stairway B — same layout as the 2nd floor.
nurseOffice: Please direct anyone who is injured or feeling unwell to the nurse's office on the 1st floor. If it seems urgent, also alert a nearby teacher or staff member.

access.walkTime: About a 5-minute walk from Youga Station's east exit to the school.
access.note: Please do not drop off or pick up by car near the school, and please do not park or leave bicycles at nearby shops.

notices: Information on this site is updated regularly. Please check for the latest details before visiting.
Event details may change or be cancelled without notice.
If you are injured or feel unwell, please go to the nurse's office on the 1st floor.
Please bring athletic shoes if you plan to join a sports club experience activity.
Outdoor experience activities will be cancelled in case of rain.
Please refrain from visiting if you have a fever, cough, or other symptoms.
Photography on campus is limited to our students, their guardians, teachers, and contracted photographers.
Even those listed above should refrain from photography except at designated photo spots.
Please do not drop off or pick up by car near the school.
Please do not park or leave bicycles at nearby shops.
